document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your  students  grumble.  There  is  some  talk  about  turning 
back.  You  sit  down  with  them  and  talk  about  the  harsh 
realities of the field and how no significant discovery was 
ever  made  by  an  expedition  that  lacked  courage.  In  time, 
they agree to continue.

If any of your party require healing, you may restore 1 hit point 
each. Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 90; if you fail, go to 85.
